_comment: Design tokens of the documentation site, from the Taktsim design system. The single source for website/theme/tokens.css (generated), the concept scripts' SVGs and the in-browser components. Regenerate with: python3 docs/concepts/scripts/build_all.py

line.usage: Hairlines, axes, outlines of empty steps.

acid.usage: The firing step: one highlighted element per figure.

keyline.usage: Outline of acid marks; on light grounds it keeps acid visible.

signal.usage: Machine down: the one colour besides acid, for failures only.

states._comment: Machine states. Each is told apart by fill and pattern, not by colour alone.
